artworks.title: Interior of a House
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic interior scene. The scene depicts an interior space with a basket filled with vegetables, including a squash and leafy greens, on a stone floor next to a shoe. In the background, hanging cloths are seen on a stone wall, and a kettle sits over a stone hearth. The drawing includes detailed textures of stone, fabric, and a woven basket.

artworks.title: Old, Bald-headed Shepherd, Seated Shepherd Boy and Flock
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a pastoral scene with livestock in an arched rock shelter. Various animals such as goats, sheep, and a cow are shown resting or grazing. The scene is set under a natural stone arch with lush vegetation surrounding the animals. The detailed drawing highlights the textures of the animals' fur and the rugged surface of the rocks. In the background, there are structures indicating human activity, possibly a farm or a resting place for the animals. The composition creates a harmonious balance between nature and structure, evoking a peaceful rural ambiance.

artworks.title: Woman, Shepherd Boys, and  Sheep near an Arch
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of people and animals near a stone structure. The scene features a sheep, goats, a boy, a woman with a shepherd's crook, and a man in the background. Surrounding rocks lead to a mountainous landscape. The artwork uses a monochromatic palette with varying shades of grey. The stone structure has vegetation hanging down, framing the composition.

artworks.title: Seated Old Man and Woman with a Basket of Eggs
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic rural scene with animals and structures. The drawing features a woven hay structure, various animals, two human figures engaging in everyday rural activities, lush landscape with trees and bushes, soft rolling hills, and a modest building in the distance.

artworks.title: Seated Shepherd before a Flock of Goats
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with goats in the foreground, a shepherd sitting on a rock, and another figure overseeing animals in the distance. The landscape includes rolling hills, mountains, trees, and a sky with clouds. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of grey, creating a serene rural atmosphere.

artworks.title: Seated Shepherd Boy and Woman Giving a Drink to a Child
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three people and several animals in a rustic setting. One person is seated on the ground holding a stick, possibly engaged in knitting or mending. Another person stands nearby, holding a large round object, with a child reaching eagerly for it. The child is reaching for the object, seemingly a melon. A dog rests near the seated figure, and cows are seen lounging to the left. The background includes dense foliage and a tunnel-like entrance in the rock.

artworks.title: Seated Shepherd and a Peasant Woman with a Basket
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural pastoral scene. A figure is seated on the ground, leaning against a bundle, wearing aged clothing. Beside them, a woman holds a basket of food. In the background, goats and sheep graze, tended by a distant figure. Nature elements, like bushes and hills, are present. Additional objects, such as a pot and mountains, enhance the rustic setting.

artworks.title: Old Man Leaning against a Sack
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene near a cave entrance. The drawing depicts an elderly figure reclining near the entrance of a natural rock formation, surrounded by various animals and objects. There is a basket filled with vegetables and fruits, sheep, a donkey, a goat, and a dog. Other objects such as a pot, bread, and a stick accompany the figure. The background shows a rustic rural setting with dense foliage above the cave and a cloudy sky in the distance. The drawing features intricate linework and shading, creating texture and contrast.

artworks.title: Peasant Man with a Sack and Two Shepherdesses
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene featuring a group of shepherds and their flock. The horizon line is visible with a wooden fence and some leafless trees, suggesting a countryside setting. The artwork is an etching with detailed cross-hatching creating textures and shades. The color palette consists of neutral tones like brown and gray. In the foreground, there are sheep and goats with their shepherds, one woman gesturing while the others tend to the animals. In the background, rocky outcrops and foliage can be seen.

artworks.title: Sleeping Shepherd Boy and  Woman with a Child
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: A man is sitting against a tree, seemingly asleep. Next to him, a woman holds a basket and gestures. A boy is beside the man, looking at the woman, while a goat is near the woman. In the distance, a man rides a donkey surrounded by sheep and a cow. The landscape includes trees and rolling hills, giving depth. The image is monochrome, with detailed brushstrokes depicting foliage and clothing, creating an engraving style. The scene is serene and rustic, with a soft backdrop of trees enclosing the figures in pastoral activity.

artworks.title: Interior of a Stable with a Seated Spinner and Sleeping Child
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a child seated in a rustic setting. The woman is seated on a large stone block, facing the viewer, with her head slightly tilted to her right. She has a weary expression on her face and long hair covered by fabric wrapped around her head. Her clothing appears to be loose, flowing garments, possibly a robe or dress, which is layered and draped. Next to her, a young child stands leaning against the wall, using their sleeve to rub their nose or face. The child has short hair and wears simple clothing. In the foreground surrounding them, several sheep are scattered, some lying down, others standing. On the right side, there is a large basket containing more wool or sheep. The background consists of a rough stone wall and possibly a thatched roof above.

artworks.title: Shepherd Wearing a Cape Driving a Flock
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with livestock. The image shows a collection of farm animals, including sheep, goats, and a cow, in a rural setting outdoors among rocks and trees. The animals are grouped together, with the cow in the center. The landscape, including foliage and branches, is intricately rendered.

artworks.title: Shepherd Resting on a Walking Stick with an Old Horse and a Reclining Bull
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with domesticated animals and a person outdoors. A cow is sitting, a horse is grazing, and a person in rustic clothing stands nearby. In the distance, a group of sheep rests amidst rocky terrain. The background shows rocky formations and a barren tree. The artwork is created with detailed etching techniques, using fine lines and hatching to depict texture and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, utilizing different shades of gray to highlight form and detail, evoking a sense of calmness and simplicity.

artworks.title: Standing Cow and a Shepherd Boy with Flock
artworks.medium: etching with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with animals and a man in a pastoral setting. The point of view is at eye-level with the animals. A cow, goats, and sheep are seen, with a man in the background. The scene is detailed with fine brushstrokes creating a textured feel. The image uses cross-hatching technique and a monochromatic color palette of grey and black.

artworks.title: Seated Shepherd with Horse, Dog, Goats and Sheep
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This etching depicts a pastoral scene viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is not prominently featured. A horse stands on the left side, with a hunched back and a long mane. A shepherd is seated near a cave entrance, playing a flute. A dog rests at his feet, and a goat stands nearby. The cave shelters several sheep. The artist uses fine lines to create texture and detail. The color palette is monochromatic, in black and white. The background features minimal foliage and thin tree branches.

artworks.title: Two Shepherds with a Cow and Calf
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with two shepherds and various animals in a natural setting. The foreground shows two cows and a shepherd, while a goat and a sheep are also present. In the background, cliffs and distant hills can be seen, suggesting a rural landscape. The artwork is detailed with a color palette of warm greys.

artworks.title: Standing Shepherdess with a Child
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a cow, sheep, and a rocky landscape. In the scene, a cow is reclining on the ground next to several sheep. In the background, there is a rocky hillside with foliage on the right side. The ground is textured with grass and dirt, indicating a natural outdoor environment. The animals and plants are detailed, reflecting a meticulous etching or engraving technique. The image conveys the tranquility and simplicity of rural life.

artworks.title: Allegory of Painting with Three Cherubs (99)
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau the Elder after François Boucher
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black on laid paper
artworks.description: Three cherubs are depicted on what appears to be a cloud-like setting. One cherub sits with another intertwined cherub, gazing towards the viewer, featuring curly hair. The second cherub lies across the first, focused on drawing on a scroll. The third cherub is lying down, holding the scroll steady. Each cherub has small wings, a youthful face with chubby cheeks, and wears draping fabric. The background is intricate, suggesting a celestial atmosphere. Text and decorative lion and shield elements are present in the lower section of the image.

artworks.title: Allegory of Music with Two Cherubs and Doves (100)
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau the Elder after François Boucher
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two cherubic figures close together. The cherub on the left is reclined, with its head resting on the shoulder of the other cherub. The cherub on the right faces the left cherub. Both have curly hair and are depicted nude. The left cherub holds a scroll and wears a laurel wreath, while the right one holds a lyre. They are surrounded by drapery. The background features swirling clouds. Below the main image is a heraldic emblem with a lion, crown, and banner with integrated text.

artworks.title: Four Cherubs at Target Practice
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after François Boucher
artworks.medium: chalk manner in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four cherubs playing in the clouds. The scene captures four cherubic figures, each with plump bodies and wings, interacting playfully among themselves. One cherub at the center holds a bow, another is leaning towards this central figure, and the other two cherubs are engaged, one holding an arrow and the other gazing towards the central activity. The soft, curved lines and use of chiaroscuro add to the ethereal and playful atmosphere. The arrangement suggests movement, conveyed through the swirling cloud-like forms that envelop the cherubs.

artworks.title: Three Cherubs Playing on Dolphin Like Wave
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after François Boucher
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black on laid paper
artworks.description: Three cherubs are depicted, interacting playfully. One is lying on its back, another on its stomach, and the third is sitting up slightly with its head resting on its arm. The cherubs have plump, youthful faces with curly hair, characteristic of cherubic figures. Small wings are visible on their backs. They are unclothed. The background consists of wispy clouds, creating a heavenly setting around the figures.

artworks.title: K. baierische Infanterie (Bavarian Infantrymen)
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white on grey/green paper
artworks.creditLine: Ellwanger/Mescha Collection, gift in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a group of soldiers in full military uniform. They are standing in different poses, such as with arms crossed, holding rifles, or sitting on a drum. The soldiers have defined facial features and are wearing large fur hats, military jackets, trousers, high boots, belts, backpacks, drum sticks, rifles, and swords. In the background, there are buildings with pitched roofs and a chimney emitting smoke.

artworks.title: Austrian Dragoons
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white on gray-green paper
artworks.creditLine: Ellwanger/Mescha Collection, gift in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a military camp scene with horses. The foreground features two horses fitted with saddles and gear, standing side by side. To the right, a figure in military attire with a helmet and plume stands near the horses, looking out toward the horizon, while another figure is seen reclining on the ground, resting with a musket beside them. Behind the figures, a tent is pitched, suggesting a temporary encampment. The background reveals a landscape of rolling hills and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Russian Soldiers with a Barber
artworks.medium: etching heightened with white on gray-green paper
artworks.creditLine: Ellwanger/Mescha Collection, gift in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse-drawn carriage on a dirt path. The drawing features a covered wagon with detailed shading, wooden wheels with spokes, and a robust structure. There are individuals in historical clothing around the wagon, one seated on a barrel, another sitting on the wagon, and a third standing with arms crossed. In the background, there is a tree with detailed leaves and branches, as well as a rural landscape. The drawing emphasizes textures of fabric, wood, and the environment, capturing a moment from a bygone era.
